job.title: Senior Business Consultant (m/w/d) - PIM / MDM
job.email_subject: Application: Senior Business Consultant – PIM / MDM
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

PIM/MDM projects need someone who understands product data from the business side and the integration side – I built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee and solved ERP/MDM bottlenecks at Rockwell Automation.

– PIM-to-commerce pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Requirements, functional specifications and UAT
– International stakeholder work

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for Hiveway.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Senior Business Consultant PIM / MDM | Integrations, Requirements & Data Flows
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional consultant with 5+ years in PIM and MDM integration for global e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams. Bridges business and IT through requirements engineering, user stories, functional specifications, process mapping, gap analysis and UAT. Uses AI tools extensively in analysis and documentation. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Hiveway focuses on PIM and MDM consulting – exactly the field I have worked in from the integration side for years. I want to bring that hands-on understanding of how product and master data flows between PIM, MDM, ERP and commerce into client projects, close to Karlsruhe in Heidelberg. I look forward to contributing.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Senior Business Consultant PIM / MDM role fits my profile: PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, ERP/MDM integration and requirements work at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Based in Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Happy to talk!

en.subject: Application: Senior Business Consultant – PIM / MDM
en.hook: PIM and MDM projects succeed when someone understands both the business view of product data and the integrations that move it. That has been my focus for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation I designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee and resolved bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and the shop, working directly with business and international technical teams.

bullets.label: PIM / MDM integration
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, keeping product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Complex data landscapes
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams.

bullets.label: Business consulting
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications, mapped processes and supported UAT.

bullets.label: Data consistency
bullets.text: Engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved system stability and data consistency.

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit and can start at Hiveway on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation to show you the concrete contribution I can make to your team.
